backgrounds.name: the flow out of the hole
backgrounds.description: Space flowing out of a white hole of 4 million solar masses at the escape speed, u = sqrt(2GM/r): at the speed of light at the Schwarzschild radius (1.18e10 m), slower further out. It slows as it goes, so its acceleration g (dark arrows) points back in, at GM/r^2: a white hole attracts, as a black hole does.
